data.headline: Review the video. Make every call.
data.lead: The prep station between your camera and your editor.

data.headline: Bring in the event.
data.lead: Choose a camera card or local folder. Review copies are prepared locally; your source footage stays unchanged.

data.headline: The app points. You decide.
data.lead: A useful starting order. Keep, Highlight, or Reject — every call stays yours.

data.headline: Hand off, ready to edit.
data.lead: Organized local outputs and a versioned decision map. Nothing uploads on its own.

data.headline: Analysis points. It never decides.
items: Does not decide what is good
data.foot: The operator is the authority at every stage.

data.headline: AGPL-3.0, because it has to be.
data.lead: It bundles Ultralytics and YOLO weights, whose terms require publishing the whole work. The licence is an obligation, not a pose.

data.headline: Three questions.
items: Before you opened it — did you understand what it does?
In the first twenty minutes, where did you get stuck?
What did you expect it to do that it didn't?
